ligand_docking._doc: Coarse-grained molecular recognition: neutral beads with Lennard-Jones (van der Waals) interactions. Rigid-receptor approximation via heavy receptor beads, as in classical docking (DOCK, Glide).

lennard_jones._inter_note: Ligand-receptor ε is 0.45× ligand-ligand ε: intramolecular cohesion beats intermolecular adhesion, so the ligand docks as a unit instead of wetting the receptor surface. Same idea as intra/inter nonbonded scaling in molecular force fields.
